What's this weird building?\nIs this the Raden Tower they were talking about?
It's a conch shell, isn't it\nThat means something this huge used to be alive?
That's impossible! It's obviously man-made!
...But still, it's a conch shell. It looks pretty\nsturdy~. I don't think we can just smash our way\nin.
And since it's a conch shell, if we get cornered,\nthere won't be any way out.
It'd be a total nightmare if a Coenubia monster\nshowed up here.
Aye! There's no Coenubia here!
What? Your gut feeling is never reliable~.
Aye! It's reliable!
Okay, prove it then!\nShow us the proof that there's no Coenubia here~!
Aye! I just have this feeling!
Sigh...You should first learn the meaning of the\nword "proof" from Kunon properly.
Well, since we're already here, I guess there's no\nturning back. Let's go!
